title: SEBI Flags ₹87,124 Crore as Difficult-to-Recover Dues in FY26 (Up 12%)
summary: Highlights regulatory enforcement recovery challenges despite record annual fee collections.

blocks.content: Highlights regulatory enforcement recovery challenges despite record annual fee collections.

items: SEBI Fee Revenue: Total fee income rose 10% to ₹2,563 crore (stock exchange regulatory fees generated ₹1,349 crore).
Investor Protection Fund (IPF): Fund balance rose to ₹965 crore; investor education spend stood at ₹2.25 crore.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: ⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
